name: apm
description: Agent Package Manager — install, remove, scan, and repair AI agents and skills across harnesses.

interface.shortDescription: Install, remove, scan, and repair AI agents and skills across harnesses.
interface.longDescription: apm is the Agent Package Manager: one library of skills and agents, installed into whichever harness you use. Install or remove a skill, list what is installed, scan for duplicates, register tool-embedded skills, sync an agent to GitHub, and repair broken symlinks.
